title: GEMIL: Gated Expert Multiple Instance Learning for Weakly Supervised Whole-Slide Image Classification
description: GEMIL core research implementation for weakly supervised whole-slide image classification. Includes GMEA, training-only TAM, gating and training losses, training/validation/testing entry points, medical-SSL configurations, and fixed split CSVs for CAMELYON16, BRACS, and TCGA-NSCLC. WSI images, feature files, trained checkpoints, and experimental analysis code are not included. See README.md for usage. The historical checkpoint-selection rule uses test AUC plus test F1 and is preserved for consistency.
